newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank says rates have reached bottom.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank says rates have reached bottom.

text.p: Interest rates in Austria have reached a bottom and there is little room for further easing, Austrian National Bank director Adolf Wala said on Monday.
"We have reached an equilibrium on the financial markets," Austrian news agency APA quoted Wala as saying.
He added the economy already showed signs of a lasting recovery after a temporary downturn earlier this year and said latest inflation figures were reassuring.
"It looks like (the economy) is picking up," Wala said.

Rates in Austria have reached a historic low after the National Bank last week followed the Bundesbank's lead and cut its securities repurchase rate to three percent from 3.20 percent, and the Gomex money market rate to 3.4 percent from 3.5 percent.
The Austrian discount rate remained unchanged at 2.50 percent and the Lombard emergency financing rate steady at 4.75 percent. -- Knut Engelmann, Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
